title: Passage and Landfall
author: Odile Ravensworth
blurb: Rosalind Sterling, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
